hero.headline: Two Specialities. One Clinic. One Less Appointment to Juggle.
hero.subheadline: TS Diabetes Center and Women's Health Clinic brings together diabetes management and gynecological care in Mugalivakkam — because so many of our patients need both, and shouldn't have to visit two different clinics to get it.

about.title: Built around a simple observation
body: So many women managing diabetes also need regular gynecological care — for PCOS, pregnancy, thyroid issues, or routine checkups. Yet most clinics make you choose: a diabetes specialist here, a gynecologist across town.

TS Diabetes Center and Women's Health Clinic was set up to close that gap. Under one roof in Mugalivakkam, our team manages blood sugar and hormonal health together — because in the body, they're rarely separate problems anyway.

Whether you're here to get your HbA1c under control, manage PCOS, plan a healthy pregnancy alongside diabetes, or simply want a women's health checkup with a doctor who understands your full picture, we're set up to see you properly, not just quickly.

faqs.question: What specialities does this clinic cover?
faqs.answer: We combine two specialities under one roof: diabetes and general medicine care, and women's health and gynecology. Many of our patients use both.

faqs.question: What should I bring for my first visit?
faqs.answer: Please bring any previous medical records, current medications, and recent lab reports if you have them. If not, that's fine too — we can start fresh.

faqs.question: Do you accept insurance or is payment out of pocket?
faqs.answer: We currently operate on a direct-payment basis. Please contact the clinic to confirm accepted payment methods before your visit.

faqs.question: How do I book an appointment?
faqs.answer: You can book through our appointment page on this site, or call us directly at +91 99622 12491.

faqs.question: If I need both a diabetes consultation and a gynecology consultation, do I need two separate appointments?
faqs.answer: Not necessarily. Let us know when booking that you need both, and we'll do our best to coordinate a single visit covering both consultations.

blogPosts.title: Why Diabetes Management Matters More During Pregnancy
blogPosts.excerpt: Gestational and pre-existing diabetes both raise the stakes during pregnancy. Here's why close monitoring across both specialities makes a real difference.
blogPosts.author: Dr. Senthil Kumar
content: Pregnancy changes how your body processes insulin, which is why blood sugar control matters even more during these nine months — whether you already had diabetes or developed gestational diabetes along the way.
Poorly controlled blood sugar during pregnancy raises the risk of complications for both mother and baby, including higher birth weight, preterm delivery, and a harder recovery after birth.

This is exactly the kind of situation where having diabetes and gynecology care under one roof helps. Your prenatal visits and your blood sugar monitoring don't happen in isolation — both doctors are looking at the same picture and adjusting your plan together.

If you're pregnant and managing diabetes, or if you've just been flagged for gestational diabetes, the most useful first step is a joint consultation that looks at your pregnancy and your blood sugar as one connected story, not two separate problems.
